name: Can water-efficient upgrades improve water pressure?

mainEntity.name: Can water-efficient upgrades improve water pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water-efficient upgrades, particularly low-flow showerheads and faucet aerators, are designed to maintain perceived water pressure while using less water. Many modern fixtures incorporate air-infusion technology to create a satisfying flow experience. However, actual pressure is determined by your home's plumbing system; if you have naturally low water pressure, some fixtures might not entirely compensate. We can evaluate your current pressure during an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water-efficient upgrades use technology to maintain perceived pressure with less water. Actual pressure depends on your home's plumbing, which we can assess.
